text: ここは　こどもの　くる　ところ　じゃない！

structure.jp: こどもの　くる　ところ　じゃない！
structure.en: is no place for kids to come!

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: こどもの　くる　ところ
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing word describes it; inside such a phrase の can stand in for が to show who does it. こどもの　くる　ところ = 'a place that kids come to'.
